title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana/log-shipping for Private installs + Terraform/Helm upgrade hooks
author: Aisha Patel
description: Automates the Prometheus + Grafana + log-shipping setup for Private (VPC/on-prem) installs and wires this into the installer/upgrade flow. Scope: 1) Add Terraform module and variables to provision managed observability components in customer VPCs (security groups, subnets, IAM roles where applicable), 2) Helm chart updates for prometheus-operator and grafana with opinionated dashboards, CRD patches, and default alerting rules, 3) Fluent Bit/Fluentd helm chart and Elasticsearch/Logstash output config templates for log shipping, 4) Installer hooks (pre-upgrade/post-upgrade) to reconcile monitoring resources during upgrades and rollbacks, 5) E2E smoke tests in perf-canary for metrics ingestion and dashboard provisioning. Motivation: reduce manual steps customers need to run to enable full observability on Private installs and make upgrades safe (avoid dangling alerts or missing dashboards). This change bundles infra as code + chart defaults + installer orchestration so that Private installs created via the installer (or via terraform apply + helm release) have a usable observability stack out of the box. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module for observability resources (vpc-aware) - [x] Helm charts: prometheus-operator bump + default dashboards - [x] Fluent Bit chart + templates - [x] Installer hooks and idempotent reconcile logic - [x] Tests: unit + integration smoke in perf-canary - [x] Documentation updates and quickstart snippet Link to design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4127/observability-automation-private-installs

merge_info: merged via squash (1 commit) by Marcus Li on 2025-09-28. Commit message: 'obs: automate prometheus/grafana/log-shipping for private installs (terraform + helm + installer hooks)'
release_notes: Adds automated observability provisioning for Private installs: Terraform module for VPC-aware monitoring resources, Helm defaults for Prometheus/Grafana/Fluent Bit, installer upgrade hooks to reconcile dashboards and alerts, and smoke tests. No breaking changes. To opt-out set observability_enabled=false when running the installer or terraform module.
notes_for_ops: When upgrading existing private installs: run installer with --reconcile-observability to migrate dashboards and silence rules. If customers have custom grafana dashboards, set grafana.overwriteDashboards=false to prevent overwrite.
security_notes: Default deployments create minimal roles and service accounts. Secrets (ES credentials) are templated to use KMS/HSM-backed secret manager; document recommends customer-provided credentials for production. See docs/private/observability.md for KMS integration.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for helm value rendering, terraform module unit tests (terratest), and a perf-canary smoke job that deploys a small private cluster, validates prometheus targets, ingests synthetic metrics, and verifies grafana dashboards are provisioned.
user_impact: Improves out-of-the-box observability for Private customers. Opt-out is supported. No API changes to public Redwood API. Minor additional IAM and networking resources are created when observability_enabled=true.
migration_instructions: For existing installs: 1) run terraform apply with new observability module (or set observability_enabled=true), 2) run installer with --reconcile-observability, 3) verify dashboards in Grafana and silence windows for first 24h if desired.
doc_updates: docs/private/observability.md added with quickstart, KMS integration, troubleshooting, and rollback steps. Also updated installer README and release notes.
